title: 第116章 你敢抄袭我？
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 炎文帝一直担心唐逸玩砸了，心头又激动又担忧，你个兔崽子装个啥？站在男人的角度写出一首绝世好词，还不够你嘚瑟的？你还非得去站在女人角度去搞事情！却没有想到，这家伙站在女人的角度，竟然也写出了一首好词。凄凄婉婉，藕断丝连，断人愁肠……这是一个血气方刚的少年郎，能写出来的诗词？这小子，到底经历了什么？当然，这些不重要，重要的是他可以抡起巴掌，好好地教训教训这群文臣了。“好，好，此处该有掌声，掌声呢？给朕把掌声送给唐逸。”炎文帝站了起来，看着唐逸鼓掌大笑。全场还在震惊中，很多人都各怀心思，还想着怎么扳回局面，结果见到炎文帝亲自带头鼓掌，以示对唐逸的肯定，他们还能说什么？只能跟着鼓掌了。就算再怎么不爽，皇帝的面子还是得给的。啪啪……激烈的掌声，响彻全场。“客气了，客气了，不用这么客气……”面对全场的掌声，唐逸也是很给面子地站了起来，笑着冲着众人拱手还礼。只是说出来的话，能将人给气死。“毕竟，这只是基本操作而已。”“我刚才说了，要走你们的路，让你们无路可走，总不能说话不算话吧！”众人正在鼓掌，闻言脸都黑了，妈的脸都被打肿了，还得给他陪笑脸，这叫什么事？关键是，这家伙话虽然说得气人，但他还真将男人女人双角度都写了，还是两首绝佳的词，还真将他们的路给堵死了。特别是站在男人角度的这一首，恐怕此后几千年，都没人能超越了啊！“靠，这风头……老子都羡慕了啊！”萧棣本来不喜欢诗词，不喜欢读书，更喜欢舞刀弄棒。对他来说，他的刀就是他的理。但现在看到唐逸站在台上意气风发，他忽然觉得砍人，好像也没有那么有意思了。因为，这家伙成功做到无数人想要砍他！“咳，低调，给朕低调点。”炎文帝没好气地瞪了唐逸一眼，随即虎目扫过全场，指着唐逸道：“就是这家伙，刚才说了在场所有人都是垃圾。”“他不仅羞辱你们，他还想要成为你们的唐爷，连朕都看不下去了！”“你们都是天子门生，都是功名加身的人，岂能容他这般猖狂？”“上吧！打败他！”炎文帝指着唐逸，站在台上怂恿。众人看着他，脸皮都在抽搐，陛下，你能要点脸吗？一边告诉唐逸要低调，一边比唐逸还高调，你是皇帝啊！注意点影响好吗？众人都无语了，怎么总感觉今日的陛下，有点放飞自我了？而听到炎文帝的话，台上参与比赛的一众才子学子顿时如坐针毡，进退两难。进？就唐逸这两首《钗头凤》，上去也是丢人现眼。退，不战而溃更是丢人现眼！孔诗岚已经回过神，此时那颗悬着的心已经落回了胸口，她和炎文帝的想法是一样的，有唐逸这两首词，稳了，今日沈园诗会，胜局已定。她美眸看向舞台上的众人，道：“诸位，之前唐少说了，他若出手，诸位连出手的机会都没有了。”“我觉得他这话说得狂妄了，诸位现在可以出手，将他打败了。”闻言，舞台上众人都齐齐看向孔诗岚，你是在表达不满吗？怎么感觉你是在炫耀？他出手，我们连出手的余地都没有，这不是狂妄，这是事实！“靠，老子不奉陪了，丢人就丢人吧，我认输。”有人“啪”的一下将手中折扇折断，直接铁青着脸转身下了舞台。“咳，小诗仙才高八斗，在下甘拜下风。”“我也认输了，打不过就是打不过，没什么丢人的。”“不写，丢人一时，写了，那就是丢人一世，不玩了。”“一世？开玩笑呢？是丢人生生世世，后世人在研究这两首词的时候，老子都得上一次刑场，这还玩个毛？”“……”舞台上，陆续有人骂骂咧咧下了舞台。很快，舞台上就只剩下了稀稀疏疏的几个人。唐画，秦钰，宇文封和几个不甘心失败的学子。炎文帝看到这一幕，眼睛顿时眯了起来，哟呵，有意思，终于熬到了手足相残的戏码了。朕就喜欢这样的戏码。今日，朕倒是要看看是唐逸这小诗仙厉害，还是唐画这三元及第的状元厉害。台下，刘温，唐境等大臣的目光，也都齐齐落在唐画的身上，现在唐画可是他们唯一的机会了。就连唐逸，这时也看向了唐画，等了这么久，我就是在等你啊！来吧，让我看看，你有什么本事。而在所有人的注视下，唐画也抬步，向唐逸走去。此时，他心头已经被恐惧吞噬，脊背冷汗直冒，但面上依旧努力维持平静，不想让人看出他的恐惧。他不是不想下去，但他也知道今日一旦下去，就彻底身败名裂了。因此，他此时唯有拼死一搏。《钗头凤》两首绝世名词，他配拥有吗？他不配，这种词，只有他这个三元及第的少年状元才配拥有。而看到他向前走去，颜霜玉和姜云娜眼睛顿时都红了。“画儿，打败他，打败他……”“画哥哥，将他踩在脚下，给娜儿报仇！”颜霜玉和姜云娜在心头怒吼，对，就是这样。直接当面挑战他，将他踩在脚下，将他踩进尘埃，踩进十八层地狱。看到这一幕，唐敬嘴角也终于有了笑容，刘温，赵柯等人也都齐齐松了一口气。“哈哈，唐画，上吧，将他打趴下！”众人暗暗激动。唐逸是小诗仙，两首词带动了全场的气氛，要是唐画将他打趴下，那就不是皇帝踩他们的脸，而是他们甩皇帝巴掌了！杜凌菲，萧岚，以及站在舞台上的孔诗岚，见到这一幕也都紧张起来。就在所有人会以为唐画会和唐逸正面诗词交锋的时候，却见唐画在唐逸面前停下脚步，手缓缓指着唐逸，冰冷的声音在空气中传开！“唐逸，小诗仙？你抄袭我的诗词，抄袭得爽吗？”写是写不出来的。但是，他能抢啊！这话一出，全场死寂。就连唐逸也是脚下一个趔趄，错愕地盯着唐画。啥玩意儿？我这都准备好了，你给我玩这个？
content_en: Emperor Yanwen had been worried that Tang Yi had messed up, and he was excited and worried at the same time. What are you pretending to be, you little bastard?Isn't it enough for you to write a masterpiece of poetry from a man's perspective?You still have to deal with things from a woman’s perspective!But I didn't expect that this guy would actually write a good poem from a woman's perspective.Sad and graceful, the lotus root is broken, and the heart is broken... Is this a poem that a young man with a strong spirit can write?What has this kid been through?Of course, these are not important. What is important is that he can slap his hands and teach these civil servants a lesson."Okay, okay, there should be applause here. Where's the applause? Give it to Tang Yi." Emperor Yanwen stood up, looked at Tang Yi, applauded and laughed.The whole audience was still in shock. Many people were thinking about how to reverse the situation, but when they saw Emperor Yan Wen personally taking the lead in applauding to show his approval of Tang Yi, what else could they say?All I can do is applaud.No matter how unhappy he is, the emperor still has to give him face.Bang bang... fierce applause resounded throughout the audience."You're welcome, you're welcome, you don't have to be so polite..." Faced with the applause of the audience, Tang Yi stood up with dignity, smiled and returned the favor to everyone.Just the words you say can make people angry to death."After all, this is just a basic operation." "I just said that I have to go your way and leave you with nowhere to go. You can't keep your word!" Everyone was applauding. Their faces turned dark when they heard this. Mom's face was swollen, and she had to smile for him. What's this thing?The key is that although this guy's words were irritating, he really wrote about both men and women's perspectives, and he still had two excellent poems, which really blocked their way.Especially this one from a man's perspective, I'm afraid no one will be able to surpass it for thousands of years to come!"Damn, this limelight... I'm so jealous!" Xiao Di originally didn't like poetry or reading, and preferred to dance with a knife or stick.To him, his sword is his reason.But now that he saw Tang Yi standing on the stage in high spirits, he suddenly felt that killing people didn't seem so interesting anymore.Because, this guy succeeded in making countless people want to kill him!"Ahem, keep a low profile, keep a low profile for me." Emperor Yanwen glared at Tang Yi angrily, then swept his eyes across the audience, pointed at Tang Yi and said, "This is the guy. He just said that everyone here is rubbish." "He not only humiliates you, heEven I can't stand it if you want to be your Lord Tang!" "You are all disciples of the emperor, how can you allow him to be so arrogant?" "Go on!Defeat him!" Emperor Yan Wen pointed at Tang Yi and encouraged him.Everyone looked at him, their faces twitching, "Your Majesty, can you please have some face?"While telling Tang Yi to keep a low profile, he is even more high-profile than Tang Yi. You are the emperor!Please pay attention to the impact, okay?Everyone was speechless. Why do they always feel that His Majesty has let himself go a little bit today?After hearing Emperor Yanwen's words, all the talented students participating in the competition on the stage were immediately on pins and needles, and were in a dilemma.Enter?As for Tang Yi's two pieces, "The Hairpin-headed Phoenix", they were both embarrassing and embarrassing.Retreating and defeating without a fight would be even more embarrassing!Kong Shilan has come to her senses, and her hanging heart has fallen back into her chest. She and Emperor Yan Wen have the same idea. With Tang Yi's two poems, the victory of today's Shenyuan Poetry Recital has been determined.She looked at the people on the stage with her beautiful eyes and said: "Everyone, Mr. Tang said before that if he takes action, you will not even have a chance to take action." "I think what he said is arrogant. You can take action now and defeat him." Hearing this, everyone on the stage looked at Kong Shilan. Are you expressing dissatisfaction?Why do you feel like you're showing off?When he takes action, we don’t even have room to take action. This is not arrogance, this is a fact!"Damn it, I won't accompany you anymore. It's shameful to be embarrassed. I give up." Someone snapped the folding fan in his hand and turned around with a livid face and walked off the stage."Ahem, the little poetry fairy is so talented that I am willing to accept defeat." "I also admit defeat. If you can't beat me, you can't beat me. There is no shame in it." "If you don't write, you will be embarrassed for a while. If you write, it will be a lifelong shame and you won't play anymore.""A lifetime? Are you kidding? It's a shame for lifetimes. When future generations study these two poems, I have to go to the execution ground once. Is this a joke?" "..." On the stage, people cursed and left the stage one after another.Soon, only a few people were left on the stage.Tang Hua, Qin Yu, Yu Wenfeng and several students who were unwilling to fail.When Emperor Yan Wen saw this scene, his eyes suddenly narrowed. Haha, that's interesting. We finally got through the fratricide scene.I just like this kind of drama.Today, I want to see who is more powerful, Tang Yi, the little poetry fairy, or Tang Hua, the third-ranked number one scholar.In the audience, the eyes of Liu Wen, Tang Jing and other ministers all fell on Tang Hua. Now Tang Hua was their only chance.Even Tang Yi looked at Tang Hua at this time, "I have been waiting for you for so long!"Come on, let me see what you're capable of.Under everyone's gaze, Tang Hua also stepped up and walked towards Tang Yi.At this time, his heart was swallowed up by fear, and cold sweat broke out down his spine, but he still tried to maintain a calm expression on his face, not wanting others to see his fear.It's not that he doesn't want to go down, but he also knows that if he goes down today, his reputation will be completely ruined.Therefore, he had no choice but to fight to the death."The Hairpin-headed Phoenix", two masterpieces, does he deserve to have them?He doesn't deserve it. Only he, a young champion with three grades, deserves to have such a word.When they saw him walking forward, Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna's eyes suddenly turned red."Hua'er, defeat him, defeat him..." "Brother Hua, trample him under your feet and avenge Na'er!" Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna roared in their hearts, yes, that's it.Challenge him directly to his face, trample him under your feet, trample him into the dust, and step him into the eighteenth level of hell.Seeing this scene, Tang Jing finally had a smile on his face, and Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and others also breathed a sigh of relief."Haha, Tang Hua, go ahead and knock him down!" Everyone was secretly excited.Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy, and his two poems brought the atmosphere of the whole place. If Tang Hua beat him down, it would not be the emperor stepping on their faces, but them slapping the emperor!Du Lingfei, Xiao Lan, and Kong Shilan who were standing on the stage also became nervous when they saw this scene.Just when everyone thought that Tang Huahui and Tang Yi were having a head-on poetry confrontation, they saw Tang Hua stop in front of Tang Yi.
title_en: Chapter 116 Do you dare to copy me?
